subject: Insurance
title: Index-Based Crop Insurance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Index-Based Crop Insurance.

hook.text: Satellite imagery now triggers automatic crop insurance payouts.

buildup.text: Traditional crop insurance requires farm visits and damage assessments.

discovery.text: Index insurance uses weather data or satellite imagery as triggers.

twist.text: The index doesn't always match individual losses.

climax.text: Index insurance trades precision for scalability.

punchline.text: Satellites detect crop failure. Payouts come automatically, no paperwork needed.

quiz.question: What is the main drawback of index-based crop insurance?
options: The index may not match individual farmer losses
